crossRefs.note: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old.…
Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Zuar
people.line: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar

translations.web: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
translations.bsb: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
translations.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
translations.asv: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
